column1: # dirs components, computed: all when fd is installed, bookmarks always, as alt-m adds them from all (see lib/components.sh
# for the table format). Frecent directories are modes of the recent module.
printf 'action\tgo\t-\tgo there: the shell'"'"'s directory (from the tmux M-o popup: the pane'"'"'s, else a new window)\tdefault,become,builtin\n'
printf 'action\tmark\talt-m\tbookmark the directories (asks each a name)\tforeground,reload\n'
printf 'action\tunmark\talt-x\tbookmarks: remove the bookmarks (not the directories)\tnotify,reload\n'
printf 'action\tworkspace\talt-O\topen the directory as a tmux workspace (workspace open)\tbecome\n'
